text: The function-formatting compatibility fix is in place, and the targeted baseline run passed 440 tests. I also found that this glom version lacks several APIs named in the request; I’m adding those while preserving its existing spec-dispatch behavior. The test run also exposed unrelated compatibility failures with the current Python and PyYAML versions.

'''+s[end:]
